name: Genetic Multiple Congenital Anomalies/Dysmorphic Syndrome with Intellectual Disability
aliases: Multiple Congenital Anomalies Syndrome with Intellectual Disability
Genetic Dysmorphic Syndrome with Cognitive Impairment

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Genetic Multiple Congenital Anomalies/Dysmorphic Syndrome Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of intellectual disability confirmed by standardized cognitive testing
Presence of two or more congenital anomalies affecting different organ systems
Characteristic craniofacial dysmorphic features identified by clinical geneticist
Identification of pathogenic genetic variant consistent with syndrome
Exclusion of other known syndromes with overlapping phenotypes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of intellectual disability, multiple congenital anomalies, and distinctive dysmorphic features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended to confirm diagnosis and exclude phenotypically similar disorders.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distinctive craniofacial dysmorphism including hypertelorism and broad nasal bridge
pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic facial features aid clinical recognition
searchTerms: distinct facial features with wide eyes and broad nose
unusual face shape including broad nasal bridge

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe intellectual disability with global developmental delay
searchTerms: global developmental delay with intellectual disability

pathognomonic.symptomName: Multiple congenital anomalies involving cardiac septal defects
searchTerms: multiple birth defects including heart holes
various birth anomalies with heart defects

common.notes: Reduced muscle tone often noted early

common.symptomName: Congenital renal anomalies such as renal hypoplasia
common.notes: Structural kidney abnormalities detected by imaging

occasional.notes: Epileptic episodes may develop in childhood

occasional.symptomName: Skeletal anomalies such as clinodactyly or scoliosis

occasional.notes: Increased susceptibility due to anatomical abnormalities
Social interaction deficits and repetitive behaviors

searchTerms: weak immune system with frequent infections
repeated infections due to immune deficiency

laboratory: Elevated serum lactate in some cases
Abnormal metabolic screening in select patients
imaging: Renal ultrasound showing hypoplasia or dysplasia
genetic: Pathogenic variants identified in multiple genes associated with developmental pathways
Chromosomal microarray showing copy number variations
other: Electroencephalogram abnormalities in patients with seizures

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic facial features distinct from this syndrome
Presence of hypotonia and congenital heart defects but different dysmorphic pattern
Behavioral phenotype including hyperactivity and autistic features

redFlags: Severe global developmental delay with multiple congenital anomalies
Distinctive craniofacial dysmorphism not explained by common syndromes
Early onset seizures or refractory epilepsy
references: Orphanet: Genetic Multiple Congenital Anomalies/Dysmorphic Syndrome with Intellectual Disability, ORPHA:611327
Smith’s Recognizable Patterns of Human Malformation, 7th Edition
